description: Superfund: Search Superfund (CERCLA/SEMS) sites by location, site name, or NPL listing status. Returns site identifiers, source NPL status labels, non-NPL assessment and archive metadata when available, coordinates, and county FIPS code. A state, city, ZIP, or name search returns sites in SEMS site ID order; latitude+longitude+radius returns them nearest first with each site's distanceMiles, and name narrows either. Page through a large match with offset and nextOffset. Proximity searches match only sites with usable coordinates and share a 50-second deadline; narrow the radius or add filters if the search times out. Use epa_superfund_get_site with a returned siteId for contaminant associations.

city.description: City name (partial match within state, case-insensitive). Punctuation is matched as written ("St. Louis", "Coeur d'Alene").

exclude_archived.description: Exclude archived sites by requiring SEMS archived_ind=N; false retains all archive statuses

latitude.description: Latitude for proximity search (use with longitude and radius_miles)

limit.description: Number of sites to return in one call. Default 25; a larger value returns at most 2,500 and says so. Page past it with offset and nextOffset.

longitude.description: Longitude for proximity search (use with latitude and radius_miles)

name.description: Site name (partial match, case-insensitive), alone or with any other filter. Punctuation is matched as written.

npl_status.description: Filter by NPL status: listed=final or part of an NPL site (F,A), not-listed=N, proposed=P, deleted=D, removed=R, withdrawn=W, all=include all

offset.description: Number of sites to skip before this page (default 0). Pass the previous call's nextOffset to continue; a value past the end returns an empty page.

radius_miles.description: Search radius in miles from the given coordinates. Required when using latitude+longitude.

state.description: 2-letter US state or territory code to filter sites, e.g. "WA"

zip_code.description: 5-digit ZIP code to filter sites; a ZIP+4 searches its 5-digit ZIP. Matches sites recorded under the ZIP or any ZIP+4 within it.

name: epa_superfund_search_sites

effectiveQuery.description: The search as sent upstream, in input names: values, match modes, and result-changing defaults, "; "-joined.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `incomplete_proximity`: A proximity input came without both latitude and longitude. `no_location_filter`: No state, city, zip_code, name, or latitude+longitude. `radius_required`: latitude and longitude without radius_miles. `invalid_state`: state is not a US state, territory, or EPA region code. `unmatchable_filter`: city or name has no letter or digit. `filter_too_long`: city or name makes the request too long. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

guidance.description: Present when more sites follow: the continuing offset.

limitNotice.description: Present when a smaller limit than requested applied; says why.

message.description: Recovery hint on an empty result; absent otherwise.

nextOffset.description: Next offset; absent on the last page.

notice.description: Proximity coordinate-coverage caveat with the page's place in the nearest-first match; also present when a punctuated city or name filter hits its page limit.

distanceMiles.description: Great-circle miles from the search point, to two decimals; absent without a search point or row coordinates.

nonNplStatusName.description: Non-NPL assessment label; not cleanup progress

nplStatus.description: F final, A part of an NPL site, N not listed, P proposed, D deleted, R removed, W withdrawn

totalCount.description: Matches before limit and offset; present only on a proximity search (otherwise follow nextOffset).

title: Search Superfund Sites
